title: Social smile
guidance: A smile that answers your face or voice, rather than one that comes and goes on its own. Babies find this at their own pace.

title: Follows a face with their eyes
guidance: Their gaze stays with you as you move slowly across their view. Some days it holds, some days it does not.

title: Lifts their head briefly
guidance: During tummy time, their head comes up for a moment before resting again.

title: Cooing sounds
guidance: Soft vowel sounds that are not crying — often aimed at you, sometimes at the ceiling.

title: Brings hands to mouth
guidance: Hands find their mouth on purpose. This is exploring, not necessarily hunger.
